title: Chicken Alfredo
text:
Chicken Alfredo
https://bellyfull.net/chicken-alfredo-recipe/
(Mince garlic very small, put in early)
Use chicken broth technique for chicken
hint: Changes: mince the garlic very small and add it early. Cook the chicken with the broth technique from the 'Chicken (thigh or breast)' entry: medium heat, 6:30 on one side, then broth and 7–8 min (smaller thighs) or 10–12 min (thick breasts). From the user's Recipe List.pdf (2026-11-14).
